trap.label: sujeito expletivo
trap.wrong: Is not so much a correction as a conciliation.
trap.right: It is not so much a correction as a conciliation.
trap.why: Em português “não é tanto uma correção” dispensa sujeito. Em inglês, a oração exige it.

mcq.q: Which is the formal reply to an objection?

fix.wrong: Rather than imposing a winner, we compromised.
fix.right: Rather than impose a winner, we compromised.

fix.wrong: Is less about tools than about people.
fix.right: It is less about tools than about people.

fix.wrong: We respectfully disagree for that point.
fix.right: We respectfully disagree on that point.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com rather than: “We did not impose a winner; we compromised.” (Rather than…)
